title: Fix jmap-vtc-filenode-guide.md: wrong capability URI
description: MUST-FIX: Guide uses capability URI 'urn:ietf:params:jmap:filenode' but the correct URI is 'urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:filenode'. The filenode capability is scoped under the chat namespace. This will cause capability negotiation failures — clients advertising the wrong URI won't match what the server advertises, and vice versa.
close_reason: All issues fixed across 11 VTC files
